_comment: Tier-0 Wood-side gather material. Wedge of clay dug from a damp seam in the forest floor where the loam gives way to a finer, denser layer. Rarer than common bark or loose earth -- requires the right kind of ground. Hell cannot heal: materials for medicinal preparations are gathered above, never below. Clay poultices have period-medicinal precedent, which gives the substance honest grounding in the cosmology.
name: Clay
description: A grey-brown lump prised from a seam in the loam. Cool and heavy in the palm, smooth where the fingers pressed it, the surface still bearing the marks of whatever scraped it free.
